Chapter 683 - 683 Introduction; Banquet!

Chapter 683 - 683 Introduction; Banquet!

683 Introduction; Banquet!

The man was very clear about the rules of the world.

The strong were respected!

According to the Heavenly Protection System, Lin Fan was a supreme expert who could cross the Chaosverse.

He had to treat him respectfully.

Otherwise, if he made the other party unhappy, Lin Fan could just casually blow on him and he would probably turn into ashes.

He would even punish his relatives and friends to appease the other party’s anger.

Lin Fan nodded. “What’s your name?”

“Jack,” the man said respectfully.

“Jack, why don’t you introduce your Star Lord to me?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes,” Jack replied.

It turned out that the Star Lord of this planet was called Qing Song, a Star Traveller level warrior. He was also the only Star Traveller level warrior on the planet.

Being able to walk through the Chaosverse with a physical body was one of the signs of a Star Traveller.

Lin Fan was at least at this level.

Planet Qing was located in the eastern part of the Spring Region. It was a planet that focused on technology.

Then, Jack drove the flying vehicle and brought Lin Fan around.

The architectural style of Planet Qing was similar to that of Earth.

Lin Fan did not have any thoughts of admiring it.

Not far away, a dozen flying vehicles stopped in front of a towering building like birds.

At this moment, a silver-white aircraft arrived in front of Jack.

Then, a woman in a white dress walked down and said with a smile, “Uncle Jack, I didn’t expect you to come over to celebrate my birthday.”

Jack looked at Lin Fan carefully and said, “Sir, this is my niece. She doesn’t know that I’m receiving you. I’ll let her leave now.”

Lin Fan waved his hand. “No worries. There aren’t many birthdays in life. It’s better not to miss them. Let’s go and take a look together.”

“Ah… This…” Jack was stunned.

He wanted to refuse.

However, he was worried that rejecting him would make Lin Fan unhappy.

Therefore, he could only bite the bullet and say, “Yes.”

Then, he slowly opened the door of the aircraft and said, “Today is your birthday. Of course, I have to come.”

“Uncle is the best!” the woman said happily.

At this moment, she noticed Lin Fan in the flying vehicle and could not help but size him up curiously.

“Uncle, is this young man your subordinate?”

As soon as he said this, a thin layer of sweat immediately appeared on Jack’s forehead, and his legs were trembling.

Subordinate?

This was simply disrespectful!

This would probably make the lord angry.

It was over!

Jack was about to scold the woman.

Lin Fan said, “I’m Jack’s friend.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he cast a reassuring look at Jack.

When Jack saw this, he heaved a sigh of relief.

At the same time, he knew that he could ont expose Lin Fan’s identity.

The woman sized Lin Fan up and said, “Friends? But he’s so young.”

Then, she smiled and said, “Hello, my name is Jerry.”

“Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said.

The three of them talked as they walked toward the tall building.

Of course, it was mainly Jerry who spoke.

Jack looked very uncomfortable.

As for Lin Fan, he was not familiar with this place and just listened quietly.

After a while, the three of them arrived at the tall building.

This was a place similar to a hotel on Earth.

It was towering and majestic.

The banquet hall on the third floor was filled with many beautiful flowers.

Many guests were chatting, drinking, and eating inside.

When they saw Jerry, they all greeted her.

“Isn’t this our birthday girl today?”

“Jerry, you’re so beautiful today!”

“She’s like a princess!”

…

Hearing everyone’s praise, Jerry was also very happy. Her pretty face was like a flower, extremely radiant.

“Thank you, everyone! Thank you for coming to my birthday party.”

At this moment, a tall woman walked over and said, “Jerry, happy birthday.”

As soon as she finished speaking, she handed over the beautifully wrapped gift box in her hand.

“Thank you, Minmin!” Jerry said.

Then, she opened the gift box.

Inside was a soft dress.

“Wow!” Jerry said. “What a beautiful dress. Minmin, thank you!”

The others also handed out their gifts.

“Happy birthday, Jerry.”

“Happy birthday.”

There were communicators, game consoles, toys…

The smile on Jerry’s pretty face grew wider.

At this moment, a middle-sized young man walked over and said seriously, “Jerry, happy birthday.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he handed over a very luxurious gift box.

Jerry hesitated for a moment but still accepted the gift and opened it.

Suddenly, a dazzling gem appeared in front of her.

The crowd immediately burst into gasps of praise.

“What a beautiful gem!”

“Bora Star Stone! What a huge Bora Star Stone!”

“This is at least a million universe dollars!”

…

Jerry’s eyes were lit up by the gemstone.

However, she quickly handed the gem over and said, “This… This is too expensive. I can’t take it.”

“There’s no such thing as an expensive birthday present,” the young man said. “The important thing is that you like it.”

Jerry turned around hesitantly and looked at Jack.

After all, Jack was her elder and had a lot of knowledge.

His opinion was very important.

However, in the eyes of the young man, it was a completely different situation.

He liked Jerry.

He had been observing Jerry from afar and realized that she had walked in with Lin Fan.

Moreover, they were talking and laughing.

The young man had seen all of Jerry’s relatives, and he was sure that Lin Fan was not one of them.

Thus, from the start, he was filled with hostility toward Lin Fan.

Before Jerry accepted his gift, she even had to ask Lin Fan for his opinion.

This made the young man even more hostile.

He took a deep breath and said, “My name is Kevin. Hey, you over there… You look a little unfamiliar.”

Lin Fan could feel the hostility from the other party.

However, he did not pay too much attention to it and said, “I’m Lin Fan.”

Kevin nodded. “Today is Jerry’s birthday. I wonder what present you’ve prepared for her?”

He firmly believed that his gift was definitely the most expensive present.

He wanted to make Lin Fan understand just how big the gap between them was. He wanted to make Lin Fan retreat!

How could Jack not understand Kevin’s thoughts?

His heart trembled.

One had to know that Lin Fan was at least on the same level as the Star Lord!

This kind of expert had always been temperamental.

If he was displeased, it would definitely be a huge disaster!

At that time, not only Kevin, but himself and even everyone present would suffer an incomparably terrifying disaster!

Jack opened his mouth, wanting to stop him.

However, he did not dare to speak carelessly.

Lin Fan willed it and took out a crystal clear spirit stone from his internal space.

This was the product of the spirit stone mine after the forbidden land merged with Earth a thousand years ago.

It was considered a rare treasure for ordinary people.

“Jerry, happy birthday.”
